Score Delta

Score delta using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

score_delta(baseline, candidate)

Example input

{
  "baseline": {
    "correctness": 4,
    "autonomy": 4,
    "actionability": 4,
    "safety": 4,
    "concision": 4
  },
  "candidate": {
    "correctness": 4.5,
    "autonomy": 4.5,
    "actionability": 4.5,
    "safety": 4.5,
    "concision": 4.5
  }
}

Example output

0.5

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py score_delta < examples/score-delta.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
